_comment: The exact sample .osm stems generate_samples.py must produce, in order. Derived from the sample tables in btap-necb/scripts/generate_samples.rb (SAMPLES 01-10, STAGED 11-12, STRESS_CASES 13-16) and cross-checked against a run of that Ruby generator. Both generators are asserted against this list in BOTH directions, so a corpus that silently shrinks fails loudly instead of passing vacuously.
